scripts.title: Simple Noclip
scripts.features: -Noclip
scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait() -- Waits for the character if not loaded

for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        part.CanCollide = false
    end
end

comments.text: (Just a little warning, if you die or reset, noclip just straight up stop, so just re-execute, then you good! :D)
